# Release checklist

Game / version / candidate commit:

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and docs/QUALITY.md satisfied
- [ ] npm run check passes
- [ ] Manual playtests recorded on supported targets
- [ ] Asset rights and attribution complete
- [ ] Save migrations tested, if any
- [ ] Release notes and known issues written
- [ ] Download/frame budgets measured
- [ ] game.json status and controls accurate
- [ ] Public catalog and game links checked in production preview
- [ ] PR merged; Pages deployment succeeds
- [ ] Live URL, start/restart, and hard refresh verified
- [ ] Release tag and deployed commit recorded
- [ ] Rollback commit identified
